params.body:
## Why

On the vehicle sheet, "Externe listing (eigen website)" tells the dealer what the system stores, not what he has to do. The field is the link to *this* vehicle's own page on the dealer's own website, and it only makes sense for a dealer whose site has a page per vehicle (tools such as Catchline read that link). Dealers were filling it in with their homepage, or leaving it blank because "listing" reads like something Stocklist does elsewhere.

The old help line described the format (URL, relative path, slug) and the API, which the placeholder already shows and which nobody needs while filling the sheet. It now says the one thing that decides it: fill it in or leave it empty.

Wording only. No field names, no ids, no `wire:model`, no validation, no behaviour; the translation keys (`external_listing_path`, `_help`, `_placeholder`) are unchanged, so nothing that reads them breaks. The required markers are untouched.

## What each label says now

| | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nl | Externe listing (eigen website) | Link naar deze wagen op je eigen website |
| en | External listing (your website) | Link to this vehicle on your own website |
| fr | Annonce externe (votre site) | Lien vers cette voiture sur votre propre site |
| de | Externes Inserat (eigene Website) | Link zu diesem Fahrzeug auf Ihrer eigenen Website |
| es | Anuncio externo (su web) | Enlace a este vehículo en su propia web |

Help line under the field (muted, one line):

- nl: Enkel invullen als je eigen website een aparte pagina per wagen heeft; anders laat je dit leeg. Sommige tools gebruiken deze link.
- en: Only fill this in if your own website has a separate page per vehicle; otherwise leave it empty. Some tools use this link.
- fr: À remplir uniquement si votre propre site a une page distincte par voiture ; sinon, laissez vide. Certains outils utilisent ce lien.
- de: Nur ausfüllen, wenn Ihre eigene Website eine eigene Seite pro Fahrzeug hat; sonst leer lassen. Manche Tools verwenden diesen Link.
- es: Rellénelo solo si su propia web tiene una página propia por vehículo; si no, déjelo vacío. Algunas herramientas utilizan este enlace.

The classic sheet (`ownstock/_tabs/dates.blade.php`) already rendered the help line; the Livewire sheet did not, so it gains one `<small class="ui-field-help">` with the same key. The placeholder keeps showing that a relative path or slug is allowed.

## Other labels worth rewording

Found while going over the keys the sheet uses. None of these are changed here: each one may be a word the dealers actually use, and guessing that wrong is worse than the current text. Questions for Shane:

1. `vehicle.modixportals` / `vehicle.send_to_modix` — "Portals". Modix is the system; "Portals" is already neutral but still jargon. Do dealers say "portalen", "zoekertjessites", or plain "Portals"? Proposal if a rewording is wanted: **"Zoekertjessites"** for the heading and **"Doorsturen naar zoekertjessites"** for the action.
2. `vehicle.sendToNederlandMobiel` — "België - NederlandMobiel", and `is_on_nederland_mobiel` — "op nederlandMobiel". The partner name is presumably one dealers know, but the spelling is the system's (`nederlandMobiel`, three variants across the file). Proposal: settle on **"Nederland Mobiel"** everywhere, text unchanged otherwise.
3. `vehicle.carpass_init` "Carpass" / `vehicle.carpass` "carpass" / `vehicle.do_carpass_request` "Car-Pass aanvragen" — the same thing spelled three ways. The official name is Car-Pass. Purely cosmetic, but it is one screen. Settle on **"Car-Pass"**?
4. `vehicle.battery_health_soh` — "State of Health van de batterij (SOH)". English standard term in a Dutch sheet. Proposal: **"Batterijconditie (SOH)"**, keeping the abbreviation the dealer sees on reports.
5. `vehicle.nedc_emission` / `vehicle.wltp_emission` — "NEDC uitstoot (OLD)" and "WLTP uitstoot (NEW)". NEDC and WLTP are terms dealers use, but the `(OLD)`/`(NEW)` is English and shouting. Proposal: **"NEDC-uitstoot (oud)"** / **"WLTP-uitstoot (nieuw)"**.
6. `vehicle.visible_for_close_dealers` — "niet zichtbaar voor lokale dealers" on what is, judging by the key, a *visible-for* switch. This one is not wording alone (a label that states the negative of its own switch either is a mistake or describes the checked state), so it needs a look at the behaviour first, not a rewrite here.

Say the word on any of these and they go in the same branch.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` compiles, `php -l` clean on every compiled view.
- `phpunit --filter='Vehicle|VehicleForm|OwnStock|SmokeTest|Lang|Translation'`: 259 tests, 783 assertions, OK (1 skipped, pre-existing).
- `phpunit --filter='StylesheetSyntax|BuildContract'`: OK, 4 tests — the new `ui-field-help` use is a class that already exists.
- No test asserts on this label text. `VehicleFormSaveTest` uses the field name only, which is unchanged.
- The three language lines also exist as rows in `language_lines` (migration `2026_05_12_120001`), but the DB translation loader was removed from `config/app.php`, so the files are the only source at runtime. No migration added.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: clearer labels
